instruction:
Merged House And Garage Model

Use the opened Bonsai IFC authoring environment to merge /home/user/Desktop/house.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/garage.ifc into one IFC4 model. You may use /home/user/Desktop/combined_overview.png, /home/user/Desktop/garage_plan.png, and /home/user/Desktop/house_plan.png as local reference images. Save the outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv. The merged model must contain one IfcProject named Merged House Garage, one IfcSite named Default Site, one IfcBuilding named Default Building, and one storey named Ground Floor. Include four spaces, ten walls, and three slabs. Do not include doors, windows, roofs, proxies, furniture, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep every IfcRoot GlobalId unique.

Create spaces named House Living, House Bed, House Kitchen, and Garage Bay. Their dimensions must be House Living 3.70 m by 5.40 m by 2.80 m, House Bed 3.50 m by 2.70 m by 2.80 m, House Kitchen 3.50 m by 2.50 m by 2.80 m, and Garage Bay 5.40 m by 3.90 m by 2.80 m. Name the slabs House Slab, Garage Slab, and Connector Apron. House Slab must be 8.00 m by 6.00 m by 0.20 m, Garage Slab must be 6.00 m by 4.50 m by 0.20 m, and Connector Apron must be 2.00 m by 1.20 m by 0.12 m. Assign all spaces and slabs to Ground Floor.

The CSV must use the exact headers BuildingPart, Storey, GrossFootprintArea, SpaceCount and contain two rows: House with Storey Ground Floor, GrossFootprintArea 48.0, and SpaceCount 3; and Garage with Storey Ground Floor, GrossFootprintArea 27.0, and SpaceCount 1. Other representation details may vary.
